page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E3.Flex.32-512 is a memory-dense virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 architecture. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 7742 processor operating at a base clock frequency of 2.25 GHz. The instance configuration allocates 32 physical cores and 64 virtual processors (vCPUs) with simultaneous multithreading enabled at two threads per core. System memory is sized at 512 GB, delivering an 8 GB per vCPU allocation ratio across the configuration.

The instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage, meaning persistent disk performance relies entirely on network-attached block volumes. Furthermore, it contains no discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Network connectivity includes a single complimentary public IPv4 address alongside virtual cloud network interfaces for communication within the infrastructure.

Cost efficiency is driven by the flexibility of resource sizing and high memory density per compute core, allowing large datasets to reside directly in system RAM without provisioning excessive compute units. VM.Standard.E3.Flex.32-512 is suited for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, including in-memory caching tiers, large relational database deployments, big data analytics engines, and large-scale batch processing environments.
